H_model: Existing frozen NEXT AR8 and ARCH1/ARCH2/EWMA normalizers; no online coefficient fitting.
causality: Forecast variance uses previous capped squared innovations only; current residual updates conditional state after current evidence is computed.
channel_calibration: Replay H with H-fitted parameters, burn min(160, H_residual_length // 4), center by H mean and divide by H SD floored at 1e-6; channel evidence clips at +/-12.
score_identity: Gaussian log-likelihood derivatives with respect to omega/H_variance, alpha1, alpha2; finite-difference checks passed.
interpretation: Features only; no formal likelihood validity or posterior probability claim under non-Gaussian/serially dependent innovations.

candidates.hypothesis: Conditioning residuals on changing volatility can absorb a true scale break. Preserve the forecast state and conditional likelihood score, not only its standardized residual.
candidates.change: Add H-calibrated raw energy, forecast log variance, standardized energy and intercept/lag1/lag2 Gaussian variance scores; normalizer, feature-removal and ranking variants are explicit.
candidates.expected_effect: Retain variance-model mismatch and adapted variance-level evidence under bounded causal updates.
candidates.risks: Historical residuals fit both AR and variance reference; conditional Gaussian scores need not be well calibrated under tails; correlated evidence is learned as features and never multiplied as independent probabilities.
